title: Catalog entry frontmatter
description: The machine-readable contract every file under catalog/entries/ must satisfy. Like the recipe schema this is a flat map of scalars and inline arrays so tooling stays dependency-free.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the catalog.

title.description: Human name shown in CATALOG.md and the gallery.

category.description: Primary medium / output form. Must match the containing folder under catalog/entries/.

kind.description: What the entry is: a collection of many things, a single work, a tool, an agent skill, a written guide, or an official resource.

tier.description: Recommendation tier. featured = editor-picked and attributable; notable = clear signal; community = submitted, unvetted.

source_url.description: Canonical origin of the work or collection. Every entry must be traceable to a real, public URL.

author.description: Creator or maintainer handle, credited as-is.

has_prompt.description: Whether the entry ships a usable prompt. Prompts are welcome but not required — a great demo with no prompt is still a valid entry.

prompt_note.description: Optional one-line note about the prompt (where it lives, what it produces).

stars.description: Optional GitHub star count at catalog time. A snapshot, not a live value.

signals.description: Short, checkable reasons this entry is recommended. Inline array.

added.description: ISO date the entry entered the catalog.
